title: OKaraoke
features: Built OKaraoke, a website that turns YouTube videos link into a karaoke experience with lyric alignment and pitch scoring.
Front-end: Developed animated Cover, Loading screen (Disk), and Scoring UI components with TypeScript, Tailwind, and DaisyUI.
Implemented Python audio-processing with Aubio for MIDI conversion and pitch extraction.
Analyzed microphone input and compared it to MIDI data for real-time pitch scoring.

title: Rubik's Cube Website
features: Built an interactive website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to teach Rubik's Cube solving techniques.
Implemented dynamic navigation and visuals for step-by-step instructions and algorithm demos.
Designed a responsive, clean layout with flexbox integrating images and text for clarity.
Explained complex math concepts like permutations and group theory through interactive visuals.

title: Restroom Finder Web App
features: Developed a web app to help travelers locate restrooms, filtering by cost, accessibility, cleanliness, and water availability.
Designed responsive frontend layout using HTML, CSS, and Flexbox, incorporating placeholders for map, water availability, and filter sections.
Created UI mockups in Figma and translated designs into functional web pages.
Participated in a hackathon environment, delivering a working MVP within limited time constraints.
